audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant holds via two complementary mechanisms: (1) `claimTokenAllocation` funds each per-investor vesting clone with exactly `amountToBeVested` and sets `hasSettled = true`, preventing any second funding; (2) OZ `VestingWalletUpgradeable` maintains `balance + released = amountToBeVested` (constant), so `vestedAmount = _vestingSchedule(balance + released, t) ≤ amountToBeVested`, ensuring `released ≤ amountToBeVested` at all times. Monotonicity follows from OZ's `_erc20Released[token] += releasable` which is never decremented, with `releasable ≥ 0` guaranteed by the same invariant.
